messages:
Olivia Grant: LumenAI filed a discrepancy: their local token counts for April don't match our invoice (we're ~6% higher). They provided a sample payload and our SDK counts fewer tokens than the ledger. Can eng check tokenization pipeline?
Marcus Chen: Passing this to infra. Which sample? Olivia can you paste the sample session id?
Olivia Grant: session s_lum_992 included prompt with mixed CJK + emoji + long code block. They say SDK v1.3 counts 18,240 tokens; invoice shows 19,344.
Ravi Shah: Preliminary: I pulled billing_event rows for org=lumenai for 2026-04-10 00:00-04:00 UTC. I see token_count fields derived in two places: edge_token_count (edge tokenizer v2) and billing_token_norm (billing aggregation run using tokenizer v1 fallback). Looks like an overlap window where billing service was rolled back to tokenizer v1 and didn't match edge counts. Sample logs: ```
{"ts":"2026-04-10T01:12:04Z","org":"lumenai","session":"s_lum_992","edge_token_count":18240,"billing_token_norm":19344,"tokenizer_version_edge":"v2.0.1","tokenizer_version_billing":"v1.7.4"}
```
Ravi Shah: Query summary (billing mirror):
```sql
SELECT sum(billing_token_norm) as billed_tokens, sum(edge_token_count) as edge_tokens
FROM billing_events
WHERE org='lumenai' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-04-10T00:00:00Z' AND '2026-04-10T04:00:00Z';
-- billed_tokens: 19,344,000
-- edge_tokens: 18,220,000
-- delta: 1,124,000 tokens (6.17%)
```
Priya Nair: So billed_tokens > edge_tokens? Customer SDK showed fewer tokens than invoice. They expect invoice to match edge counts. Finance: do we treat edge_token_count as source-of-truth?
Marcus Chen: We always intended edge_token_count to be canonical for billable units. Billing pipeline should have normalized to edge_token_count; however during an emergency rollback on 2026-04-10 we reverted the billing worker image which shipped an older tokenizer binary. That caused billing normalization to use v1 tokenizer.
Olivia Grant: LumenAI asks for corrected CSV and a credit if we decide ledger overstated. They want audit lines showing tokenizer versions.
Priya Nair: Approve investigation and dry-run backfill that replaces billing_token_norm with edge_token_count for the affected window and produces CSV + checksum. If dry-run confirms delta ~=1,124,000 tokens we'll proceed with one-time credit. Need eng dry-run and per-event diffs. :white_check_mark:
billing-bot: Automated precheck: tokenizer backfill requires (1) snapshot export (2) dry-run CSV + md5 (3) finance approval.
Ravi Shah: Starting dry-run: replacing billing_token_norm = edge_token_count for events where tokenizer_version_billing != tokenizer_version_edge and edge_token_count is present. Will output CSV with columns: event_id, edge_token_count, billing_token_norm_before, billing_token_norm_after. ETA ~2h.
Olivia Grant: Draft customer note: "We traced the discrepancy to a transient mismatch between the tokenizer versions used at the edge and in our billing normalization during an emergency rollback. We will correct our ledger to match edge tokenization and issue a one-time credit of approximately $112.40 (exact amount after dry-run). Attached CSV and audit logs." Approve?
Priya Nair: Approve provisional wording. Finance requires exact dollar calc after dry-run. Also ask accounting whether correcting ledger (preferred) or issuing a credit without altering ledger is better for audits.
Ravi Shah: Dry-run finished. Upload: s3://fin-audit/dryruns/1820001234-tokenizer-backfill.csv md5=5a7c9e2b3f1d4c6a8b9e0f1d2c3b4a5e. Rows=3,412. Sum(edge_token_count)=18,220,000. Sum(billing_token_norm_before)=19,344,000. Sum(billing_token_norm_after)=18,220,000. Delta = -1,124,000 tokens.
Priya Nair: Finance: confirmed dry-run numbers and checksum. Approve ledger correction to align billing_token_norm to edge_token_count and to issue a one-time credit equal to the delta × LumenAI price. Please calculate final dollar amount and prepare invoice adjustment.
Marcus Chen: Eng action items: (1) run controlled backfill commit which writes idempotent correction records referencing backfill_run_id=1820001234-tokenizer-fix (2) add audit_marker recording tokenizer_version_edge and tokenizer_version_billing per event (3) patch release process to prevent rolling back billing workers without concurrent tokenizer compatibility checks.
Ravi Shah: Scheduling controlled commit now. Will include commit CSV + md5 and a small postmortem link to ENG-5420.
billing-bot: Commit gated: awaiting accounting reconciliation ID and final commit md5 upload.
Olivia Grant: Once commit and credit generated, I'll send final note to LumenAI with CSV and explanation. Thanks all.
